quests.title_en: To Gaze Upon the Dreaming Pale Crown
quests.description_chs: 根据「灰眸」的指引，他其中一块力量的碎皮似乎就在至冬宫之后，那巨大的「沙皇白桦」生长之处…
quests.description_en: According to the directions from the Eye of Graeae, one of the fragments of his power is located behind Zapolyarny Palace, where the Tsar's White Birch grows...

quests.title_en: The Stone Beasts, Like Ghouls Seated
quests.description_chs: 想办法在白沙皇昔日的行宫也是今日的陵寝之中，寻找到「灰眸」力量的一部分吧…
quests.description_en: Find a way to track down the fragment of the Eye of Graeae's power inside the mausoleum that was once the Belyi Tsar's itinerant court...

quests.description_chs: 乘坐升降梯后，礼堂已经近在眼前…
quests.description_en: You've taken the elevator up. Now, the assembly hall is right in front of you...

quests.description_chs: 掉入了神秘的下水道，需要想办法尽快回到地面上…
quests.description_en: You fall into a mysterious sewer. Now, you have to find a way to get back up as quickly as possible...

quests.description_chs: 风雪中亮着一盏孤灯…
quests.description_en: A lone lamp shines in the snowstorm...

quests.description_chs: 要完整回收「灰眸」的力量，得先回收分散在各处的力量碎片…
quests.description_en: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...

quests.description_chs: (test)钟楼$UNRELEASED
「仪式」还没有最终完成，必须在那之前阻止帕芙琳娜…
quests.description_en: The ritual is not yet complete. Better stop Pavlina before that happens...

quests.description_chs: 最近是千灵映影节，不如回枫丹一趟，说不定能遇到些老朋友呢？
quests.description_en: The Fontinalia Film Festival is coming up. Why not head back to Fontaine? You might just run into some old friends there.

quests.description_chs: 在见朋友之前，她似乎想先解决自己的「错谬」…
quests.description_en: Before meeting her friends, she seems intent on resolving "anomalies" within herself first...

quests.description_chs: 获得了「第二次出生」的她，会想要做些什么呢…
quests.description_en: Now that she has been "born anew," what will she choose to do next...?

quests.description_chs: 映影成功上映，而她似乎也变了不少…
quests.description_en: The film premiere is a success, and she seems to have changed much...

quests.description_en: Follow Nastya "home"...

quests.description_chs: 战胜了扎拉后，快去寻找娜斯佳吧…

quests.title_chs: 普洛克路斯忒斯的寝床
quests.description_chs: 赫斯珀利德斯之馆的所谓婚礼并非想象中那般美好，帕芙琳娜要将伊科尔作为牺牲献祭以实现愿望，所幸仪式被阿克西妮娅打断，帕芙琳娜也被拽入影域之中，与阿克西妮娅周旋…
quests.description_en: The so-called wedding at the House of Hesperides turns out to be less delightful than expected. Pavlina tries to sacrifice Ikor for her wish, though she is fortunately thwarted by Aksinya in the end. Pavlina is also thrown into the Shadow Realm, where she will continue to face off with Aksinya...

quests.title_chs: 伟大的心锁于纤细之链
quests.title_en: A Great Heart Fettered by Slender Chains
quests.description_chs: 在冻土的暴风雪中间，居然看到了一个巨大的身影…它究竟是为什么被冰雪塑造的锁链捆缚在了这冰原之上呢？
quests.description_en: Deep amidst the permafrost's howling blizzards, a towering silhouette suddenly catches your eye... Why is it bound to these icy plains by chains forged from pure snow and ice?

quests.title_en: Like a Labyrinth Imprisons Her Servants
quests.description_chs: 曾一度被锁链捆缚于冰原之上的巨人这次出现在了海边…他到底先要去往什么地方？
quests.description_en: The giant once bound by chains upon the tundra has appeared by the sea... Where is he headed first?

quests.description_chs: 要完整回收「灰眸」的力量，得先回收分散在各处的力量碎片…
quests.description_en: To recover all of Goggles' power, you and Paimon will have to collect the various fragments scattered all over...

quests.description_chs: 冰雪的巨人似乎想要用胸口的火焰点亮影域中浮现的灯塔。看来，得融化灯塔上的冰雪，他才可能做到这一点…
quests.description_en: The giant of ice and snow seems to want to light up the lighthouse appearing in the Shadow Realm with the flame in his breast. It seems that you'll have to melt the snow around the lighthouse first...

quests.title_en: Burn the Storehouses and the Stables
quests.description_chs: 走在路上，见到了至冬帮派的成员在欺负至冬的市民，虽然出手帮忙解决了纠纷，但是在这场小小的纠纷背后似乎还隐藏着更复杂的情况。
quests.description_en: While on the road, you witness members of a Snezhnayan gang oppressing members of its citizenry. You step in and resolve the problem, but a far more complex situation lies behind this seemingly tiny conflict.

quests.description_chs: 「伊兹梅洛」确实在其头目「小阁下」的带领下，企图找到能够打开影域的办法。为了知道更多的情报，我们得从据点救出失联的潜伏人员葛列娃…
quests.description_en: The Izmaylovs are indeed trying to find a way to open the Shadow Realm under the leadership of its boss, the Little Sire. To gather more information, we must rescue Gureva from their base, an undercover operative who has lost contact...

quests.description_chs: (test)你在洞穴里遇见了个神秘人……$UNRELEASED
在路过海屑镇南边的伐木场时，居然遇到了欺负当地伐木场工人的兽怪…好像又是帮派成员惹的事？看来是我们应该出手的时候了！
quests.description_en: While passing a lumberyard south of Morepesok, you unexpectedly ran into some Volkodlaks harassing the local workers... Looks like it's trouble stirred up by gang members again? Seems like it's time for you to step in.

一块奇怪的冰正漂浮在水面。从管道传来的神秘声音宣称，冰下正有一座木屋倒悬。将附近的碎冰清除，或许就能让木屋的真身显现…
quests.description_en: A strange block of ice floats upon the water. A mysterious voice comes to you over a pipe system, claiming that there is a wooden cabin hanging upside down beneath the ice. Clear the brash ice nearby, and you might cause the cabin to show its true form...

quests.title_en: The Sunken Ship Sailed Past, Ringing No Bells
quests.description_chs: 一座冰上的木屋停在水面。这似曾相识的木屋里，或许正有一位老熟人驻足。他又遇到麻烦了吗？过去确认一下情况吧…
quests.description_en: A wooden cabin has come to a stop above the water. This rather familiar house may currently play host to a certain old acquaintance. Is he in trouble again? Head over to ascertain the situation...

quests.description_chs: 冰上的木屋似乎马上就要沉向海底。这段时间究竟发生了什么？那位不愿上岸的屋主是否还在木屋中？靠近木屋看看吧。
quests.description_en: The cabin on the ice seems but a hair's breadth from sinking into the sea. What happened while you were gone? Is the owner of the house, who refused to get ashore, still in there? Approach the cabin to check it out.
